required_patches.description: Pass the resolved lld path as argv[0] instead of the literal "ld.lld", so MLIR's ROCDL target finds the linker when it is not on PATH under that name.
Support waves_per_eu min,max range attribute for full VGPR utilization.
Allow overriding xnack=any codegen to xnack- or xnack+ on gfx1250 via LLVM_GFX1250_ANY_XNACK_CODEGEN env var.

extensions.description: SLP: when the ordered reduction tried by HorizontalReduction::tryToReduce vectorizes nothing, give back the scheduling budget it spent and do not retry its root. Without this, the failed attempts that llvm/llvm-project@94e366ef2060 introduced exhaust the per-block budget in large unrolled kernels and block the vectorization that follows (ROCm/FlyDSL#1273). The tryToReduceOrdered path is not covered. Switch: -fly-slp-ordered-reduction-refund, on by default; a kernel turns it off with compile_hints={"llvm_options": {"fly-slp-ordered-reduction-refund": False}}.
